mechanism: 할인율 상승의 변화가 채용·고용 유지·구직 여건 경로를 통해 실업률의 증가로 이어질 수 있다는 조건부 설명 초안이다.
conditions: 논문의 처치·결과 정의와 대상 기업의 변수 정의가 일치할 것
논문의 모집단·시기·제도 및 효과 발생 시차가 적용 대상과 부합할 것

원자료 R05057의 적용 맥락: U.S. labor and financial markets across the 20th and early 21st centuries (long series 1929–2014, main annual analyses 1948–2013, JOLTS and industry series 2001–2014). Units are firms’ vacancy–hire relationships, newly hired workers, unemployment, industry job values, and stock-market claims (S&P 500, dividend strips). The paper links Diamond–Mortensen–Pissarides search-and-matching theory to observed vacancy, hiring, tenure, wage, and stock-market data, emphasizing business-cycle episodes (notably the 2007–09 financial crisis) to argue that higher financial discount rates reduce job creation and raise unemployment.
